passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David was the king of Israel.
David trusted God.
David praised God in his songs.

passages.text: Ascribe to the LORD, O heavenly beings, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
He speaks to the heavenly beings.
He tells them to give honor to the LORD.
He tells them to give strength to the LORD.
He calls them to recognize the LORD’s glory and power.
passages.original: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְדָ֫וִ֥ד הָב֣וּ לַֽ֭יהוָה בְּנֵ֣י אֵלִ֑ים הָב֥וּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה כָּב֥וֹד וָעֹֽז׃

passages.text: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
He speaks to the heavenly beings.
He commands them to give glory to the LORD.
The LORD deserves glory because of His name.
He tells them to worship the LORD.
They must worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness.
passages.original: הָב֣וּ לַֽ֭יהוָה כְּב֣וֹד שְׁמ֑וֹ הִשְׁתַּחֲו֥וּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה בְּהַדְרַת־ קֹֽדֶשׁ׃

passages.text: The voice of the LORD is over the waters; the God of glory thunders; the LORD is heard over many waters.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD is glorious.
The LORD’s voice is over the waters.
The God of glory thunders.
The LORD’s voice is heard over many waters.
passages.original: ק֥וֹל יְהוָ֗ה עַל־ הַ֫מָּ֥יִם אֵֽל־ הַכָּב֥וֹד הִרְעִ֑ים יְ֝הוָ֗ה עַל־ מַ֥יִם רַבִּֽים׃

passages.text: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is majestic.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is powerful.
The LORD is majestic.
The voice of the LORD shows His power.
The voice of the LORD shows His majesty.
passages.original: קוֹל־ יְהוָ֥ה בַּכֹּ֑חַ ק֥וֹל יְ֝הוָ֗ה בֶּהָדָֽר׃

passages.text: The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars; the LORD shatters the cedars of Lebanon.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is powerful.
The LORD speaks with a mighty voice.
The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars.
The LORD shatters the cedars of Lebanon.
passages.original: ק֣וֹל יְ֭הוָה שֹׁבֵ֣ר אֲרָזִ֑ים וַיְשַׁבֵּ֥ר יְ֝הוָ֗ה אֶת־ אַרְזֵ֥י הַלְּבָנֽוֹן׃

passages.text: He makes Lebanon skip like a calf, and Sirion like a young wild ox.
passages.sermon:
The LORD acts with great power.
The LORD makes Lebanon move.
Lebanon skips like a calf.
The LORD makes Sirion move.
Sirion jumps like a young wild ox.
passages.original: וַיַּרְקִידֵ֥ם כְּמוֹ־ עֵ֑גֶל לְבָנ֥וֹן וְ֝שִׂרְיֹ֗ן כְּמ֣וֹ בֶן־ רְאֵמִֽים׃

passages.text: The voice of the LORD strikes with flames of fire.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is powerful.
The LORD speaks with authority.
His voice strikes.
His voice sends out flames of fire.

passages.text: The voice of the LORD shakes the wilderness; the LORD shakes the Wilderness of Kadesh.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is powerful.
The LORD speaks with a mighty voice.
The voice of the LORD shakes the wilderness.
The LORD shakes the Wilderness of Kadesh.
passages.original: ק֣וֹל יְ֭הוָה יָחִ֣יל מִדְבָּ֑ר יָחִ֥יל יְ֝הוָ֗ה מִדְבַּ֥ר קָדֵֽשׁ׃

passages.text: The voice of the LORD twists the oaks and strips the forests bare. And in His temple all cry, “Glory!”
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks with a powerful voice.
The LORD’s voice twists the oaks.
The LORD’s voice strips the forests bare.
Everyone in the LORD’s temple cries, “Glory!”
passages.original: ק֤וֹל יְהוָ֨ה׀ יְחוֹלֵ֣ל אַיָּלוֹת֮ וַֽיֶּחֱשֹׂ֪ף יְעָ֫ר֥וֹת וּבְהֵיכָל֑וֹ כֻּ֝לּ֗וֹ אֹמֵ֥ר כָּבֽוֹד׃

passages.text: The LORD sits enthroned over the flood; the LORD is enthroned as King forever.
passages.sermon: The LORD rules over the flood.\r\nThe LORD sits on His throne.\r\nThe LORD is King forever.
passages.original: יְ֭הוָה לַמַּבּ֣וּל יָשָׁ֑ב וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב יְ֝הוָ֗ה מֶ֣לֶךְ לְעוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: The LORD gives His people strength; the LORD blesses His people with peace.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD has people who belong to Him.
The LORD gives strength to His people.
The LORD blesses His people.
The LORD gives His people peace.
passages.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה עֹ֭ז לְעַמּ֣וֹ יִתֵּ֑ן יְהוָ֓ה׀ יְבָרֵ֖ךְ אֶת־ עַמּ֣וֹ בַשָּׁלֽוֹם׃
